author: By Jack Kelly
title: Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway will testify in Wisconsin election review
text: Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway on Wednesday told reporters she will testify after being subpoenaed as part of the Republican-backed partisan review of Wisconsin’s 2020 presidential election.
